description: This file defines classes and types related to network requests, responses, and WebSocket handling within the Playwright core library, including request interception, response parsing, and WebSocket event management.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents an HTTP request, including headers, method, URL, and related response information.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents an HTTP response, including status, headers, body, and related request.

classes.name: WebSocket
classes.description: Represents a WebSocket connection, handling message events and connection state.

classes.name: Route
classes.description: Handles request interception, allowing to fulfill, abort, or continue requests.

classes.name: WebSocketRoute
classes.description: Manages WebSocket route interception, message handling, and connection control.

classes.name: WebSocketRouteHandler
classes.description: Defines a handler for WebSocket route interception based on URL patterns.

classes.name: RouteHandler
classes.description: Manages request/response route handling, including stopping and expiration logic.

classes.name: RawHeaders
classes.description: Utility class for managing HTTP headers as array and map, supporting case-insensitive lookups.

methods.name: headers
methods.description: Returns headers as an object; deprecated in favor of headersArray.

methods.name: _actualHeaders
methods.description: Fetches the actual headers from the network response.

methods.name: allHeaders
methods.description: Returns all headers as an object.

methods.name: headersArray
methods.description: Returns headers as an array of name-value pairs.

methods.name: headerValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific header.

methods.name: headerValues
methods.description: Retrieves all values for a specific header.

methods.name: finished
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves when the response is fully received.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Returns the response body as a Buffer.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Returns the response body as a UTF-8 string.

methods.name: json
methods.description: Parses and returns the response body as JSON.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Returns the associated Request object.

methods.name: frame
methods.description: Returns the Frame associated with the request.

methods.name: serverAddr
methods.description: Returns the server address info.

methods.name: securityDetails
methods.description: Returns security details of the response.

methods.name: httpVersion
methods.description: Returns the HTTP version used.

methods.name: connectToServer
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection to the server.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message over the WebSocket.

methods.name: onMessage
methods.description: Sets a handler for incoming WebSocket messages.

methods.name: onClose
methods.description: Sets a handler for WebSocket close events.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the WebSocket connection.

methods.name: waitForEvent
methods.description: Waits for a specific WebSocket event with optional predicate.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles request/response interception, fulfilling, aborting, or continuing requests.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops route handling, optionally ignoring errors.

methods.name: willExpire
methods.description: Checks if the route handler will expire based on invocation count.

methods.name: validateHeaders
methods.description: Validates headers object for string values.
